test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding Council of Ministers (COM) of Indian Ocean Rim Association?

I. It is the highest decision-making body of the Organisation.

II. It comprises of the Minister of Finance of all member states.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Statement I:** The **Council of Ministers (COM)** of the **Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA)** is indeed the **highest decision-making body** of the organization. It is composed of the **Foreign Ministers** of all the member states. ***Hence, this statement is correct.***
 
• **Statement II:** The COM does not consist of the **Finance Ministers** of the member states. Instead, it comprises the **Foreign Ministers** who are responsible for policy-level decisions within the IORA framework. ***Hence, this statement is incorrect.***
